newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX closes touch lower, profit-taking seen.
newsitem.headline: German DAX closes touch lower, profit-taking seen.

text.p: 1156 GMT - German DAX ends slightly lower as profit-taking reverses early modest gains. Trading volumes generally low but dealers say strength of the dollar, together with upbeat spring report by Germany's six leading economic institutes allow German market to withstand most of overnight Dow fall.
* DAX-30 index of German shares ends 7.25 points lower at 3,340.33, June DAX futures off earlier highs but eight points up at 3,346.0.
* SAP only slightly higher at close, unable to hold onto strong gains made after Q1 earnings report.
* Wella flat as early rise reversed.
